content: {"episode_id":"ep-05001","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, was denied under CO-197 for precertification or prior authorization not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10), with I48.91 also submitted. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management. We submit this formal appeal with the supporting clinical documentation described above and request reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 738.30."}
